text: Binary flag from the OP title only (column: title), ignoring any "CMV:" prefix and any outcome text such as view change or delta: 1 if the title explicitly contains an absolute universal quantifier word or phrase that quantifies its claim (e.g., all, every, always, never, none, no one, nobody, everyone; examples, not exhaustive), else 0. Missing or empty title returns null. No argument, comments or outcome information is used.
